text: Dr. Jones is busy decoding the rest of the cipher from the tropics in Seattle.

evidence.quote: Now he's in Seattle, busy decoding the rest of that cipher from the tropics.

subject: Cipher clue
text: Answering yes to 'Get it?' makes Dr. Jones realize Hirocon means the cipher must be reversed.

evidence.quote: Dr. Jones: Reverse! Exactly! Hirocon is telling us to reverse the cipher!

subject: Oxford Wonder World
text: Dr. Jones asks Mike to fetch the Oxford Wonder World book to read the reversed cipher.

evidence.quote: Let's see if this works. Mike, get the Oxford Wonder World..

subject: Seattle
text: Mike slips to another time and space and arrives in Chapter 2.

evidence.quote: You slip to another time and space...
Right Page: Chapter 2

subject: Chapter 2 snowy field
text: The ground north of the field has many holes hidden by snow.

evidence.quote: The ground has many holes a head. They're hidden by snow.

subject: Axe
text: Tink gives Mike an axe in the cave, and Mike receives it.

evidence.quote: Mike, try using my axe!...You've got an axe!

subject: Tink
text: Tink is a cave man who makes tools from bones and stones.

evidence.quote: Tink: I'm Tink. I make tools from bones and stones.

subject: Pikazo
text: The paintings on the wall may be Pikazo's attempt to tell the cave men something.

evidence.quote: See his paintings on the wall...?

subject: Yum-Yum
text: Yum-Yum gulped down the cave men's children a month ago.

evidence.quote: A man munching monster Yum-Yum gulped down our children.

evidence.quote: I ask you to drive Yum-Yum from our land.

subject: Yum-Yum
text: Yum-Yum lives to the north of the cave village.

evidence.quote: Yum-Yum lives to the north. Better not go there.

evidence.quote: After beating Yum-Yum, go east then north

subject: Saving

evidence.quote: Now saving refrain from turning power off or resetting!!

evidence.quote: You're Pikazo's son! I'm sure he'll talk again!

subject: Block

evidence.quote: You've got a block!

subject: Tetrads

evidence.quote: The tetrads were hidden on Earth, some where in time...

evidence.quote: Mike you've got to travel thru time and collect the mystic tetrads!

evidence.quote: You've got a tetrad! Your life level is increased!

subject: Egypt desert

evidence.quote: Huh? Where am I? Wow! Pyramids! A sphinx! This has got to be Egypt!

subject: Egypt desert
text: Going north from the arrival point, Mike walks between two palm trees on the right side of the screen to find the path.

evidence.quote: Watch the right side of the screen for two palm trees.

subject: Jack
text: Jack offers to trade his axe after Mike has the dagger.

evidence.quote: I'll trade you for my axe. OK?
